name: Theranos
title: Was Theranos too early? No: it was fraud
question: Was Theranos too early for finger-prick blood testing?
answer: Theranos claimed to run hundreds of tests from a finger-prick of blood, raised hundreds of millions of dollars, and dissolved in 2018. The claims were false; its founder was convicted of fraud in 2022. Calling it 'too early' treats a fraud as a forecast.
verdict_reason: The core claims were false; the founder was convicted of fraud.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
